output.reason: The one-line release note [ev-707cfb9a39bd] doesn't name the commands, but the linked PR does [ev-594de9701347]. It adds four read-only Flux CLI commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind: `flux export artifact generator`, `flux get artifact generator`, `flux tree artifact generator` and `flux events --for ArtifactGenerator/<name>`. The changed-file list (new export/get/tree artifact generator files plus events.go) matches this [ev-3b1a6489b25f]. The subject is therefore concrete: these four CLI commands, newly added and read-only, with nothing stated to break. All four proposals left the subject open only because they did not use the PR text. The subject-family schema has no family for CLI commands, but that is a schema-fit problem, not missing evidence.
